## Description
Please include a concise summary of the change and the issue/feature it addresses.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New component or theme addition
- [ ] Preview engine improvement or renderer addition
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance optimization or refactor

## Affected Marketplace Areas
- [ ] Core React Components (`src/components/`)
- [ ] Preview Engine (`src/components/preview/`)
- [ ] Themes Hub / Templates Hub
- [ ] Mini-Apps / Vector Icons / Motion Studio
- [ ] CLI Scaffolding Scripts (`scripts/`)
- [ ] Documentation (`docs/`)

## Verification Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style and guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have run `npx tsc -b` and confirmed **0 TypeScript compilation errors**
- [ ] I have run `npx vite build` and confirmed the production bundle compiles cleanly
- [ ] I have run relevant automated tests (`npm run test:marketplace` / `npm run test:previews`)
- [ ] I have verified responsive UI behavior across Desktop and Mobile viewports
- [ ] Previews render safely without throwing unhandled exceptions
- [ ] I have updated documentation where appropriate
